name: The Wondrous Wisdomball offers each faction only its own Thunderbrew recipe (#7940)
contract: Blackrock Depths quests 4126 (Hurley Blackbreath, AllowableRaces 1101, Alliance)
and 4134 (Lost Thunderbrew Recipe, Horde mirror, same recipe item 11312) are the
same objective for the two factions. 4134 shipped AllowableRaces 0, so the ball,
which bypasses the Horde-only giver, offered and granted both versions to anyone.
With 4134 gated to 690, an Alliance character must never be offered or granted
4134 while still taking 4126 normally, mirroring the Blackfathom Villainy

steps.label: Obtain the companion, as a purchase would
Using the item teaches its summon
Summon the ball in Blackrock Depths
The cast produced a creature this Alliance hero owns
The ball never offers the Horde turn-in of the Thunderbrew recipe
Try to take the Horde-only version anyway, as a hostile client would
The ball refuses it outright - it never enters the log
The ball still offers this Alliance hero the Alliance turn-in
The character's own faction quest is granted
